subject: AtlasAI: post-demo questions + sample user queries for eval
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@atlasai.com>, AtlasAI Data Team <data-team@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasAI: post-demo questions + sample user queries for eval

Hi Emma — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned:

- Goal: validate model fit for AtlasAI’s end-user summarization and query assist flows (customer support transcripts + internal KB).
- Ask from your side: provide 200–500 sample user queries (mix of short/long + edge cases, PII examples) so we can run an initial model fit evaluation and quantify regressions.
- What we'll deliver: recommended model shortlist (3 variants), token-cost estimate for 1M monthly queries, a small benchmark report with qualitative failure modes called out.

Immediate asks for you:
1) Attach a CSV of ~200 sample queries (one per row) with a column for "expected behavior" (summarize/answer/high-confidence-search) if possible.
2) Flag any data that needs redaction or special handling (PII, PHI).
3) Confirm timeline: can we get samples by EOD Friday (Apr 2)?

I’m looping Marissa and Ben for eval scope and redaction guidance. If helpful we can provide a short template for the CSV — I’ve attached a minimal example.

Thanks — talk soon,
Sergio
--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@atlasai.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasAI Data Team <data-team@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: AtlasAI: post-demo questions + sample user queries for eval

Hi Sergio — great demo, thanks.

We can pull a CSV but wanted to call out a couple of constraints on our side:
- The support transcripts contain customer emails and order numbers (PII) — we can either redact or provide tokenized placeholders (e.g., <EMAIL>, <ORDER_ID>).
- We have a handful of long-running threads where users paste logs — those often exceed 2k tokens; do you want them truncated or included in full?

We should be able to deliver ~250 rows by Friday EOD if we do tokenized placeholders and truncate logs at ~1k tokens. I’ll attach the CSV when the data team hands it over.

Also: curious which open model families you think are promising given our latency constraints (sub-600ms 95th for short queries).

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Jones
Product Lead, Search & Assist | AtlasAI
emma.jones@atlasai.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Jones <emma.jones@atlasai.com>, AtlasAI Data Team <data-team@atlasai.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: AtlasAI: post-demo questions + sample user queries for eval

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Emma’s constraints. Key asks for our eval run:
1) Provide a short redaction guide we can share (what to replace vs what to keep). I sketched a one-page doc (attached: redaction_guidelines_v1.md).
2) For model recs: start with an instruction-tuned LLaMA2-70B quantized variant for quality baseline, and a smaller 13B Q4 model for latency/cost tradeoffs. Also include an LLM with retrieval augmentation (RAG + 8k context) for KB-heavy queries.
3) Can you prepare a tiny benchmark plan (50 seed queries) we can run as soon as their CSV lands? Include exact prompts we’ll use and scoring rubric (accuracy, hallucination, latency).

Emma — attaching our CSV template and the redaction guide for your team. If you want a different redaction style (token placeholders vs hashed tokens) tell us which and we’ll adapt.

Next steps:
- Emma: deliver CSV by EOD Fri Apr 2 (they said OK).
- Marissa/Ben: produce bench plan and shortlist by Mon Apr 5.

Sergio

Attachments: atlasai_sample_queries.csv (csv), redaction_guidelines_v1.md (doc)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@atlasai.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AtlasAI: post-demo questions + sample user queries for eval

Thanks everyone — quick checklist and resources from our side:

- Redaction guidance: prefer token placeholders for customer identifiers (e.g., <EMAIL>, <PHONE>, <ORDER_ID>) — keeps structure for extraction tests.
- Logs: truncate long logs to 1,000 tokens and add a final "... [TRUNCATED]" marker.
- CSV template: columns = id | raw_text | expected_intent | expected_output_short | pii_present (yes/no).

Model shortlist (initial):
- Option A (Quality): LLaMA2-70B-REDWOOD-q8 (baseline for accuracy checks)
- Option B (Cost/Latency): RedModel-13B-Q4 (fast 95th latency ~420ms on our dedicated pool)
- Option C (Retrieval): Rag-Augmented-Base (8k RAG) for KB lookup-heavy queries

Benchmark links: https://benchmarks.redwood.ai/atlasai/summary (public link to the temp report frame)
Evaluation plan: we’ll run a 50-query smoke bench Monday with those 3 variants and return a simple CSV with columns: id | model | latency_ms_95 | top_choice_match (yes/no) | hallucination_flag (y/n) | notes.

If you attach the CSV, we’ll kick off the smoke bench and aim to have preliminary results by Tue Apr 6.

Marissa
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
